TOURISM ACT, No. 38 OF 2005

REGULATIONS made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs on the adviceof the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority under Section 69 of the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 read with Subsections(3), (6) and (7) of Section 48 and Subsection (1) of Section 50 of the aforesaid Act.
JOHN ANTHONY EMMANNUAL AMARATHUNGA,Minister of Tourism Development,Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs.Colombo,04th September, 2019.
REGULATIONS
1. These regulations may be cited as Tourist (Guiding Services) Regulations No. 01 of 2019.

2. (1) No person shall carry on a service of a tourist guide lecturer unless such service is registered under therelevant category of tourist guide lecturer referred to in regulation 2(2) hereto with the Sri Lanka Tourism DevelopmentAuthority (hereinafter referred to as the “Authority”) and obtained a license for such service from the Authority.
(2) All tourist guide lecturers shall be designated into four categories on the basis of the services they areauthorized to perform as follows :-

(a)National Tourist Guide Lecturer ;(b)Chauffeur Tourist Guide Lecturer ;(c)Area Tourist Guide Lecturer ;(d)Site Tourist Guide Lecturer.
(3) Each Tourist Guide Lecturer shall possess the minimum requirements and qualifications specified inSchedule I and Schedule II hereto as applicable.
PART I
Registration & Licensing of Tourist Guide Lecturers
3. Every person who desires to carry on a service of a tourist guide lecturer under these regulations shall -

(a)submit applications for registration and licensing separately to the Director- General of the Sri LankaTourism Development Authority (hereinafter referred to as the “Director-General”) in forms as may bedetermined by him ;

(b)pay such fees specified in the Order made under subsection (5) of Section 48 of the Tourism Act, No.38 of 2005 and published in Extraordinary Gazette No. 2071/57 of May 16, 2018 together with theapplications.
(c)submit a valid medical certificate issued by a registered government medical officer certifying theapplicant is mentally and physically fit to function as a tourist guide lecturer.

(d)submit a valid proof of successful completion of training and skills development related to touristguiding amounting to a minimum of 32 hours per annum conducted by Sri Lanka Institute of Tourism andHotel Management, Sri Lanka Institute of National Tourist Guide lecturers or any other training instituteauthorized by the Authority ; and
(e)submit a police certificate of non-conviction
4. The Director General may request for further information or documents to be furnished, including anyclarification that he may consider to be necessary for the purpose of deciding such application.
5. An application found to contain false, misleading or incorrect information or particulars shall be rejected.

6. Where the Director - General is satisfied that the applicant possesses the minimum requirements andqualifications specified in the Schedule I and Schedule II hereto as appropriate, he shall register such applicant as aregistered Tourist Guide Lecturer and proceed with the licensing of such applicant.

7. Upon the receipt of an application for the issuance of a license from the registered Tourist Guide Lecturer, theDirector - General may direct the applicant to furnish such further information, documents or clarifications pertaining tothe application within such period as may be specified, for the issuance of license.

8 (1) The Director-General shall, on being satisfied that the applicant possesses the minimum requirements andqualifications specified in the Schedule I and Schedule II hereto as appropriate, issue a license to such applicant to serveas a tourist guide lecturer.
(2) The Director-General shall, inform the applicant of his decision in writing within a period of one monthand in a case of a refusal to issue the license, he shall specify his reasons therefor.

9. The license issued under regulation 8 of these regulations -

(a)may be subject to such terms and condition as specified in the license, which the Director-General maydeem appropriate for securing due compliance with the provisions of Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 orany regulation made thereunder.
(b)shall come into force on the date specified therein ; and
(c)shall unless it is earlier cancelled or revoked by the Director-General, remain in force for a period ofone year from the date specified in the license.
PART II
General Provisions
10. No person in performing his functions as a tourist guide lecturer shall carry on any function other than thefunction for which such license is issued under regulation 8 of these regulations.
11. The Director-General may on the approval of the Authority amend, modify or rescind any term or conditionattached to the license issued under regulation 8 of these regulations.
12. The Director-General shall cancel the license issued under regulation 8 of these regulations on the ground -

(a)that any provision of the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 has been violated ;(b)that any regulation made under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 has been violated ; or(c)that any condition attached to the license issued under regulation 8 of these regulations has not beencomplied with.
13. A license issued under regulation 8 of these regulations shall be renewable -

(a)on an application being made in that behalf to the Director-General in a form as may be determined byhim ;(b)not less than 3 months before the expiry of the license ; and(c)upon payment of such fees as are payable in terms of the Order made under subsection (5) of section 48of the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2071/57 of May 16,2018.

14. Any person aggrieved by a decision of a refusal or renewal or a cancellation of a license issued may, withinone month from the date of receipt of the written communication informing such person of the refusal or the cancellation,as the case may be submit an appeal to the tribunal established under Section 51 of the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005.

15. The Director-General shall casue to maintain a Register of services of tourist guide lecturers which shallcontain such particulars of the registered and licensed tourist guide services and be maintained in such form as may bedetermined by the Director-General.
16. For the purpose of giving preference to those who are proficient in rare languages, the Authority shall decidethe rare languages considering the market demand.

PART III
Terms and conditions of services

17. The Authority shall issue a valid identity card to each licensed tourist guide lecturer and it shall be the duty ofthe tourist guide lecturer to display his identity card on his person while on duty.
18. Every licensed tourist guide lecturer shall carry with him a vaild license issued by the Authority while onduty.

19. A national tourist guide lectuere shall stay with the tourist group whom they accompany throughout the tourand the hotel shall provide similar accommodation facilities to the national tourist guide lecturer as provided to thetourist group.

20. Every person who already carries on a service of a tourist guide on the date of coming into operation of theseregulations shall, notwithstanding the provisions contained in these regulations, be required to register with the Authoritywithin a period of six months from the date of operation of these regulations.
21. In these regulations

“Area Tourist Guide Lecturer” means a person who is duly registered as an Area Tourist Giude and isthereby authorized by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to practise as a tourist guideonly within the area/s specified in the liense and with a vehicle of a seating capacity of not more thanseven ;

“Chauffeur Tourist Guide Lecturer” means a person who is duly registered as a Chauffeur Tourist Guideand is thereby authorized by Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to practise as a tourist guidewith a vehicle of a seating capacity of not more than seven in any part of Sri Lanka.

“National Tourist Guide Lecturer” means a person who is duly registered as a national tourist guide and isthereby authorized by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to practise as a National TouristGuide in any part of Sri Lanka.

“Site Tourist Guide Lecturer” means a person who is duly registered as a site tourist guide and is therebyauthorized by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to practise as a Site Tourist Guide onlywithin the site/s specifid in the license.

“Tourist Guide Lecturer” means any person who provides or pefroms the tourist guide services as a NationalTourist Giude Lecturer ; Chauffeur Tourist Guide Lecturer ; Area Tourist Guide Lecturer, or SiteTourist Guide Lecturere ; and
“Tourist Guide Service” means a service provided to tourists by escorting them and giving them, informationand narrations concerning all aspects of tourist interest in Sri Lanka.
SCHEDULE I
Regulations 6 & 8
Minimum requirement to be registered for the service of a Tourist Guide Lecturer.
1.The applicant shall be a citizen of Sri Lanka .2.The age of the applicant shall be not less than 21 years and not more than 60 years on the closing date of theapplication.

3.The applicant shall be proficient in English or other foreign language/s.4.For all categories of tourist guides, preference shall be given to those who are in possession of a degreefrom a university recognized by the university grants commission in the subjects of History, Geography,Sociology, Archaeology, Botany, Zoology, Agriculture, International Relations or in any other subjectrelevant to tourism.5.The applicant shall possess a certificate of mental and physical fitness to carry out the services of TouristGuide, issused by a competent government medical officer.6.The applicant shall submit a police certificate of non-conviction for any offence.7.Selection shall be based on the performance in a selection test, interview and a language competency testdetermined by the authority.
SCHEDULE II
Regulations 2, 6 & 8
Minimum qualifications for the Categories of :
1.National Tourist Guide Lecturer (English speaking)-

(a)Shall have passed G. C. E. A/L Examination in all subjects in at least two sitting with a creidt pass for thesubjects of English ; or(b)Shall possess a degree by a university recognized by the university grant commission ; and(c)Shall have successfully completed the National Tourist Guide training course conducted by the SriLanka Institute of Tourist and Hotel Management ; and(d)Shall possess a vaild certificate issued by the Sri Lanka Institute of Hotel Managment.
2.National Tourist Guide Lecturer (Languages other than English) -

(a)Shall have passed G. C. E. A/L Examination in all subjects in at least two sittings ; or(b)Shall possess a degree by a university recognized by the university grant commission ; and(c)Shall possessed a certificate of proficiency in the language intends to practice as a Tourist Guide, issuedby an institution specified and recognized by the Sri Lanka Institute of Tourist and Hotel Management ;or(d)Shall prove language proficiency by producing credentials of living and working for at least five years ina country when the said language is the native language and successful completion of a languagecompetency test conducted by an institution recognized by Sri Lanka Institute of Tourism and HotelManagement.(e)Shall have successfully completed the national tourist guides training course conducted by the Sri LankaInstitute of Tourism and Hotel Management and shall be in possession of a valid certificate issued by theSri Lanka Institute of Tourism and Hotel Management.
3.Chauffeur Tourist Guide Lecturere -

(a)Shall have passed the G. C. E. O/L Examination with six subjects in at least two sitting ;(b)Shall have successfully completed the Chauffeur Tourist Guide Training Course conducted by the SriLanka Institute of Tourism and Hotel Management.(c)Shall be in possession of a vaild license issued by a competent authority to drive a vehicle with a seatingcapacity of seven, with at least five years of experience of driving such a vehicle.(d)Notwithstanding the requirements in regulation 14, and uninterrupted five years of good service recordas an area tourist guide with Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority with a valid license may appliedto be a registered chauffeur tourist guide.
